name: Watchdog
identity: Original stocky dark olive-brown watchdog, ochre circular coat patches, broad short dog muzzle with ivory jaw fangs, two FOLDED/FLOPPY triangular ears, thick gold collar with ivory conical spikes, four broad short paws and a TINY short wedge/stub tail with an ochre patch.

anatomy_observations.ears: Source ears are folded triangular dog ears, not erect pointed wolf ears.
anatomy_observations.head_collar: The original Head sprite includes the thick gold spiked collar. Keep collar integrated in every head state, no duplicate collar on Body.
anatomy_observations.body: Low stocky spotted torso, no mane, dorsal spikes, armor or fur ruff.
anatomy_observations.feet: Exactly four short broad paws. Up feet show rear heel/hock surfaces, not front toe/claw marks. Two mirrored forelegs and two mirrored hindlegs.
anatomy_observations.tail: Tiny pointed wedge/stub with ochre patch, not a long bushy wolf tail. Root at top of detached piece, stub extends downward from rump in rear view.
anatomy_observations.rear: Only back of head and outer backs of folded ears; all three Up head states reuse one faceless rear head. Gold collar remains at neck base.
anatomy_observations.connections: Opaque head/neck/collar overlap torso. Foreleg shoulder and hindleg hip roots extend under torso. Short tail root hidden under rump.
anatomy_observations.native_contract: Wolf Ready/Walk/Attack 0.5s, Death 0.416666657s. Preserve all native curves/PPtr/events, including Attack Event at 0.333333343 and SetHead sequence.
